name: WTI-Brent Spread: EIA Inventory & Export Drivers
description: Research study investigating the drivers of the WTI-Brent crude oil spread using EIA inventory (Cushing stocks, total US crude stocks) and US crude export data. Computes daily WTI-Brent spread, overlays with forward-filled weekly EIA series, and analyzes week-over-week inventory changes to identify potential spread drivers.
source:
# WTI-Brent Spread: EIA Inventory & Export Drivers
# ============================================================================
# Investigates whether Cushing storage levels, total US crude stocks, and
# US crude oil exports drive the WTI-Brent price spread.
# WTI = CL futures (primary asset), Brent = SC reference futures
# EIA weekly series: Cushing stocks, total stocks, crude exports (from FRED)
# ============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---

# WTI (primary asset) with futures continuation
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
wti_close = cont.c

# Brent (reference futures, ticker SC — already continuous front-month)
brent_ref = reference_futures(ticker='SC')()
brent_close = brent_ref.c

# --- WTI-Brent Spread ---
spread = wti_close - brent_close
spread_ma60 = ma(period=60, type=MAType.sma)(spread)

# Timestamp index for xy_lines x-axis
ts = index()

# --- EIA Economic Indicators (weekly, forward-filled to daily) ---

# Cushing, OK crude oil stocks (thousand barrels)
cushing_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='WCSSTUS1', use_alfred=False)()
cushing_stocks = ffill(cushing_raw.result)

# US crude oil exports (thousand barrels per day)
exports_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='WCREXUS2', use_alfred=False)()
crude_exports = ffill(exports_raw.result)

# US total crude oil stocks (thousand barrels)
total_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='WCRSTUS1', use_alfred=False)()
total_stocks = ffill(total_raw.result)

# --- Week-over-Week Changes (draw/build indicator) ---
# Use 5-day lag as proxy for weekly change on daily-frequency ffilled data
cushing_wow = cushing_stocks - (cushing_stocks >> 5)
total_wow = total_stocks - (total_stocks >> 5)

# ============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# ============================================================================

# --- Chart 1: Spread vs Cushing Stocks ---
# WTI-Brent spread (with 60d MA) overlaid with Cushing stocks level
xy_lines(
    title='WTI-Brent Spread vs Cushing Crude Stocks',
    category='1. Spread vs Cushing Storage',
    y_axis_label='Spread ($/bbl) / Cushing (k bbl)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI-Brent Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread 60d MA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cushing Stocks (k bbl)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Parity', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(spread, spread_ma60, cushing_stocks))

# --- Chart 2: Spread vs US Crude Exports ---
xy_lines(
    title='WTI-Brent Spread vs US Crude Exports',
    category='2. Spread vs Exports',
    y_axis_label='Spread ($/bbl) / Exports (k bbl/d)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI-Brent Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US Crude Exports (k bbl/d)', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Parity', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(spread, crude_exports))

# --- Chart 3: WoW Cushing Change with Spread ---
xy_lines(
    title='Cushing WoW Stock Change vs WTI-Brent Spread',
    category='3. Cushing Draws & Builds',
    y_axis_label='WoW Change (k bbl) / Spread ($/bbl)',
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cushing WoW Change (k bbl)', color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI-Brent Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(cushing_wow, spread))

# --- Summary Table: Key Current Readings ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='WTI-Brent Spread & EIA Snapshot',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Current'],
        col_headers=['Spread ($/bbl)', 'Cushing (k bbl)', 'Cushing WoW Chg', 'Exports (k bbl/d)', '1Y Avg Exports'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='Spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='Cushing'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='Cushing WoW'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='Exports'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, title='1Y Avg Exports')
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Summary',
    order=1
)(spread, cushing_stocks, cushing_wow, crude_exports, crude_exports)
